title: Your First Shift: Terminal Practice
summary: Practice prompts, commands, arguments, files, pipes and copying evidence before networking.
description: A harmless desk handover in an isolated Linux toolbox. Read a note, filter a log, and submit two practice flags.
learningOutcomes: Distinguish a prompt from a command and its arguments
Navigate and read a supplied file
Explain how a pipe filters output without modifying a file
Copy only the requested evidence into a submission

objectives.title: Filter and copy the practice evidence
